observations.body: God identifies himself as God Almighty, renames Abram, promises descendants and land, and commands circumcision.

observations.body: Abraham must walk before God; every male in the household receives the sign.

payload.posture: Read Genesis 17:1–14 as promise and the patriarchs evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The sign marks covenant membership, but the passage does not make the physical sign the whole covenant.
